IBM Plex Sans (vendored font)
=============================

Version:   3.201 (from the font files' version field)
Copyright: Copyright (c) 2017 IBM Corp., with Reserved Font Name "Plex"
License:   SIL Open Font License 1.1, full text in OFL.txt (this folder)
Files:     IBMPlexSans-VariableFont_wdth,wght.ttf         (upright)
           IBMPlexSans-Italic-VariableFont_wdth,wght.ttf  (italic)

These are the original, unmodified files from the IBM Plex Sans download
(variable fonts: one file holds every weight). They are loaded by
css/app.css with @font-face from this folder; nothing is downloaded.

Do not convert, subset, or rename the font files: under the license, a
modified version may not use the name "Plex".
